_readme: Small config the agent reads/writes each run. artifactUrl is filled in after the first successful publish and must be reused (not regenerated) on every subsequent run so updates land on the same page instead of creating a new one each day.
pagesPublishScope: every run — uses GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN if set (scheduled cloud runs), else the local gh CLI
lastRunStatus: Weekly research run. Under-covered-role target: Product Management (1 tagged opportunity entering this run, the thinnest in the catalog). Closed the gap with real new evidence rather than tagging: `product-squads-replace-project-teams` (previously Deloitte+BCG only) added a third independent institution, McKinsey's October 2026 people-and-organization research (State of AI Global Survey, n=1,719; 700+ executive interviews) finding the furthest-along AI adopters organize teams around end-to-end products rather than functional silos, with one illustrative case shrinking pods from 8-10 people to 4-6 with agent support. `Product Management` added as a role tag on this opportunity (genuine -- the finding is specifically about product-team restructuring), bringing PM-tagged opportunities from 1 to 2. evidenceScore arithmetic unchanged at 3 (all three institutions remain within the top_tier_consulting tier, so corroborationBreadth stays capped at 3 per the tier-diversity rule); the opportunity is no longer stale. Census BTOS (mandatory every run) was searched; its May 2026 story and CES-WP-26-25/61 working papers remain already-captured, so no new admission (consecutiveEmptyRuns 1->2). Separately, `ai-productivity-reallocated-not-cut` added a new, genuinely different St. Louis Fed publication (Oct 2026 write-up of a May 2026 Eighth District survey: ~20% of firms expect slight staffing reductions) -- same institution already in the trail, so breadth/strength arithmetic is unchanged (already at this trail's ceiling), but it de-risks St. Louis Fed, which had climbed to 3 consecutive empty runs, and both opportunities' summaries were rewritten from the full trail (never appended) to stay within the 4-paragraph cap. Broad rotation search covered BLS, Federal Reserve Board and five regional banks, Gartner, Forrester, IDC, McKinsey, BCG, Bain, Deloitte, PwC, EY, Accenture, NBER, HBR, Wharton, OECD, WEF, Brookings, GAO, SSRN, and arXiv; all surfaced only material already captured in prior runs or not specific/disclosed enough to admit, except the two findings above. Red-teamed all thirteen evidenceScore>=4 opportunities with targeted disconfirmation searches (governance-readiness closing, junior-hiring rebound, IT-outsourcing contraction, coding-productivity replication failures, GenAI scaling breakthroughs, cross-functional-model reversion, verification-skill commoditization, wage-premium erosion, help-desk rehiring, governance-ROI delinking, workforce-impact overstatement, OECD skills-mix reversal); no reliability>=3 evidence reversed any thesis -- several searches (McKinsey's AI-job-losses-fall-short-of-forecasts chart, OECD's management-skills finding, PwC's rising wage premium) surfaced allowlist-eligible material that reinforces rather than contradicts the existing theses. No new opportunities founded this run; no opportunity archived (none aged out of the 12-month window). Data Engineering and Help Desk/IT Support remain unchanged at 3 tagged opportunities each -- next run should rotate to one of these. Sources at consecutiveEmptyRuns>=6 and climbing: OECD (10), Deloitte Insights (10), World Economic Forum (9), MIT CISR (9, no longer mandatory), Accenture Research (9), MIT Sloan Management Review (6), EY Insights (6) -- none yet flagged as possibly dead (threshold 6; MIT Sloan Mgmt Review and EY just crossed it). See data/findings_log/2026-11-09.md for full detail. GitHub Pages mirror publish status recorded below once publish_pages.py and --verify complete.
pagesTokenPermissions: fine-grained PAT, repository access limited to sdm1130/ai-it-research-tracker, Contents: Read and write (Metadata: Read-only is added automatically). Nothing else required: main has no branch protection or rulesets, and Pages is build_type=legacy on main:/ so it rebuilds on push.

pagesPublishExitCodes.3: no credentials — skip and report mirror stale
pagesPublishExitCodes.1: real failure e.g. expired token — report loudly
